admission: Reject invalid header and negotiated bounds before payload allocation.
Sequence is contiguous per direction from 1; DATA offsets are contiguous per channel from 0.
END occurs once per channel at its final byte offset; transport EOF is not END.
CONTROL uses channel 0 and offset 0; DATA and END use admitted nonzero channels.
Correlation and dynamic channel ownership bind to authenticated session, epoch and operation.
Await destination writes before acknowledgement; replay cannot prove exactly-once publication.
Use bigint for unsigned 64-bit framing fields; canonical object offsets separately obey signed off_t limits.

scheduling.controlCapacity: Reserve bounded control admission independently of data credit before accepting native work. ACK, callback results, cancellation and lease work cannot depend on data credit they release.
scheduling.sequence: Schedule before emission; never reorder emitted frame sequences.
scheduling.fallback: Independent authenticated HTTP callback-result/cancel/signal/lease routes remain available when output-lane delivery is blocked.
scheduling.exhaustion: Pause dependent work within negotiated budgets/deadlines, then report observed cancellation, timeout or unknown outcome; never discard frames or synthesize END.

acknowledgements.uploadOffset: Validated staging only; distinct from blob commit and materialization readiness.
acknowledgements.frameCursor: Completed contiguous writes to one named consumer; persistence loss may leave delivery unknown.
acknowledgements.canonicalResult: Actual settled progress on an authorized operation; receipt loss does not authorize replay.
acknowledgements.terminal: Known or unknown effect barrier, ended production lanes and server cleanup; client writes and local cleanup settle independently.
acknowledgements.materializationRevision: Inspectable progress/readiness under the selected operation profile; not source freshness, canonical publication by private preparation, or a directory transaction.

ownership.input: Borrowed ByteSource or same-cursor optional stdinInput; never consume both. Seek requires admitted seek capability.
ownership.outputs: Borrowed ByteSink destinations; each awaited write determines delivery for that consumer.
ownership.extraDescriptors: Additive admitted-handle leases; wire IDs never authorize native fd numbers. Lease close drains operations without closing shell descriptors.
ownership.cleanup: Register before acquisition; execute finally and caller await the same idempotent local barrier. Track server termination/disposal separately.

x-boundary-admission-review.schemaSelection: Apply admission-map mandatory streaming overrides, then explicitly negotiated profile overrides; no legacy buffered fallback.

x-execute-settlement.requestBoundary: In-process structural capability object; never serialize fs, sinks, input cursor, signal, cleanup registrar or admitted handles.
resolveRequires: output END and awaited writes for this named consumer
x-execute-settlement.unknownEffectOrDelivery: Reject incomplete execute lifecycle while retaining every known native and progress observation.
x-execute-settlement.cancellation: Preserve local AbortSignal reason; cancellation request, confirmed termination and resource disposal are separate observations.
x-execute-settlement.ownership: Destination closure retires its admitted output scope; borrowed siblings, sessions and original shell descriptors retain their owners.
x-execute-settlement.lostState: No exactly-once claim, synthetic END/status, rollback or automatic native resubmission.

semanticAdmission: Accounted bound operations and cleanup; preserve acquired handle access rights.
Object identity is correlation, not handle authority or open-description cursor.
Close consumes ownership on failure; disposal drains and attempts all owned closes.
Dense owned byte directory components; malformed backend listings fail EIO, limits fail EFBIG.
No external-writer serialization, native mediation or exactly-once inference from an authority.

x-frontend-native-admission.descriptorOffsets: Current numeric input/lease facets require safe integers; exact wire offsets do not upgrade those capabilities.
x-frontend-native-admission.nativeMediation: Build-qualified live canonical mediation is required independently of grammar discovery and private materialization.

x-current-source-admission.runnerAdoption: Node server candidate only; qualify byte argv, spawn failure, signal identity, descriptor bridge and drain before adoption. No shared runner change.
x-current-source-admission.freshness: Backend-declared live reads; retained identity and materialization revision do not freeze contents. Cache only verified immutable blobs or qualified stable versions.

canonicalFacets.filesystem: accounted FileSystem; optional objects requires independent qualification
canonicalFacets.exactSeek: same-description capability, never inferred from positional read or pathname reopen
canonicalFacets.cleanup: engine finally and invocation owner await the same registered barrier

x-current-source-admission.visibility: completed live canonical effects before native acknowledgement; backend-declared read freshness
x-current-source-admission.recovery: inspect retained state; loss is unknown, never automatic uncertain resubmission
